invariant: A grant names its permission set BY NAME alone (D4): the legacy permission_set_id is retired (D10), so nothing derives a name from an id, and a non-system write naming a set the security catalog does not hold is refused 400 reference_not_found. These hooks judge no duplicate: one grant per user, set and organization is the declared unique 'organization' index's, whose NULL-safe organization key part (ADR-0120 D3) refuses a second platform-wide grant too, for every writer and write path.
